title: Customer Service & Apologies
completion_message: ¡Muy bien! Lidiar con quejas y ofrecer disculpas es una habilidad vital en el nivel B1.

stages.title: Servicio al Cliente: Disculpas y Soluciones

parts.visual: Verbos clave: Apologize (Disculparse). Complain (Quejarse). Handle a complaint (Manejar una queja). Resolve an issue (Resolver un problema). Refund (Reembolsar/Reembolso).
parts.audio: Key verbs. Apologize. Complain. Handle a complaint. Resolve an issue. Refund.

parts.visual:
Frases útiles: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience (Nos disculpamos sinceramente por los inconvenientes). 
How can I make it right? (¿Cómo puedo solucionarlo?). 
I assure you it won't happen again (Le aseguro que no volverá a ocurrir).
parts.audio: Useful phrases. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. How can I make it right? I assure you it won't happen again.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para completar la frase de servicio al cliente.

questions.question: We sincerely ____ for the delay. (Nos disculpamos).
The client called to ____ about the poor service. (Quejarse).
We received a formal ____ from a customer today. (Queja).
Our team knows how to ____ difficult customers. (Manejar / Lidiar con).
questions.explanation: Handle (a complaint, a customer) = manejar / lidiar con.

questions.question: We will ____ the issue as quickly as possible. (Resolver).
questions.explanation: Resolve (an issue/a problem) = resolver un problema.

questions.question: If you are not satisfied, we will offer a full ____. (Reembolso).
We apologize for the ____ caused. (Inconveniente).
I ____ you that this will not happen again. (Le aseguro).
What can I do to make it ____? (Arreglarlo/Solucionarlo).
questions.explanation: Make it right = solucionarlo / compensar el error.

questions.question: Thank you for bringing this to our ____. (Atención).
questions.explanation: Bring to our attention = señalarnos / hacernos notar.

questions.question: I take full ____ for the mistake. (Responsabilidad).
questions.explanation: Take full responsibility = asumir toda la responsabilidad.

questions.question: We will ____ into the matter immediately. (Investigar).
questions.explanation: Look into (a matter/an issue) = investigar / revisar el asunto.

questions.question: Please accept our ____ apologies. (Sinceras).
As a gesture of ____, we will give you a 20% discount. (Buena voluntad).
questions.explanation: A gesture of goodwill = un gesto de buena voluntad (para compensar a un cliente).

questions.question: The customer is always ____. (Tiene la razón).
questions.explanation: The customer is always right = el cliente siempre tiene la razón.

questions.question: We have to ____ the customer for the damaged product. (Compensar).
questions.explanation: Compensate = compensar (financieramente o con otro producto).

questions.question: I understand your ____. (Frustración).
questions.explanation: I understand your frustration = entiendo su frustración.

questions.question: We value your ____. (Opinión/Comentarios).
Our goal is to ensure customer ____. (Satisfacción).
Please let us know if there is anything else we can ____ you with. (Ayudar/Asistir).
questions.explanation: Assist you with = ayudarle / asistirle con (formal).
